exercises.question: Which sentence uses a relative clause for a place? [¿Cuál usa una oración relativa para un lugar?]
options: El barrio donde vivo tiene muchos parques. [The neighbourhood where I live has many parks.]
Vivo en un barrio. [I live in a neighbourhood.]
El barrio es grande. [The neighbourhood is big.]
